note: Marion County Conservation, SW edge of Knoxville (RV Life mis-tags it commercial; it is county-run). Gravel pad rows in open grass, shade moderate to limited, with an open picnic shelter and a campground host. Historic village on site. A ~3 ha fishing lake lies 130-150 m SW of the west pads across the park road and day-use lawn, not at the sites. Site water may be off in freezing weather (fill at the hydrant). --Claude
